title: Noninferiority analysis of a risk difference against a margin
summary: The risk difference with Newcombe's interval compared with a prespecified noninferiority margin, in the intention-to-treat and per-protocol populations.

sizing._why: Noninferiority has no catalog form on purpose: it is sized on the margin, by the margin-based method named in prose.

pinned_defaults: Newcombe's hybrid score interval (method 10) for the difference (new - standard); R written out, Python statsmodels confint_proportions_2indep(method='newcomb'); the Wald lower limit beside it.
Noninferior if the lower limit of the two-sided 95% interval lies above the prespecified margin (-0.10 here).
Both intention-to-treat and per-protocol analyses reported.
_itt_not_conservative: In a noninferiority trial ITT is not conservative: deviations pull the difference towards 0. On this fixture ITT concludes noninferiority (lower limit -0.091) and per-protocol does not (-0.106).
